name: Adversarial draft models raise long-horizon agent accuracy
title: Adversarial draft models raise long-horizon agent accuracy
summary: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning trains a speculative draft model to disagree at important decisions so those tokens are verified more precisely. On DeepSWE it lifts GLM-5.3 from 60.6 percent to 67.6 percent and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash from 67.8 percent to 71.8 percent without changing the target models or decode speed.
